<thought>We need the number of unique hydrogen environments in the compound, but we don't have the structure. The only way to get information is to request the 1H NMR spectrum using the provided tool, which does not require arguments. This may return the spectrum for the target compound, from which we can infer the number of distinct proton signals (i.e., unique environments). We'll call the tool.</thought>
